subject: Re: MGDT kickoff — April status + a data loader risk
body:
Hi both,

Status: offline dataset ingest is done for 41 of 46 games; the last five have replay logs with a schema quirk I'm normalizing this week. Medium-scale training started Monday and the early curve looks healthy — we're tracking the offline-RL vs behavioral-cloning comparison from the paper and, as expected, the decision-transformer objective is the most stable of the three at this scale.

Yara's first fine-tuning probe: adapting the medium checkpoint to a held-out game with ~1% of its data recovers 78% of the single-game specialist's score. Encouraging for the recipe pitch.

Risk: loader throughput. At the June config the current pipeline feeds about 60% of what 256 accelerators will eat. Wanjiru is sharding the trajectory decode; if we don't hit 95%+ utilization in the May dress rehearsal, the scaling run needs either more days or fewer ablations.

Vera
